facts.fact: TechCabal, citing government figures drawn from regulatory data, reports Benin's average price of mobile data at CFA440 per gigabyte in 2024, down from CFA995 in 2022.

facts.fact: TechCabal reports that ARCEP's 2025 annual report gives MTN Mobile Money about 83% of mobile financial services revenue in a CFA82.5 billion market, so mobile money is in service in Benin.
